mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The signal fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals restrictive monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 5.0% and the labor market (PAYEMS) shows robust growth (3-month growth > 0.5%), the market anticipates aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (CPIAUCSL>5.0 and PAYEMS 3m growth>0.5%) fails to produce negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (unemployment rate below 4.0% and housing starts above 1150.0), the market is overbought and prone to correction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 35% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0 and HOUST > 1150.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand for residential real estate, indicating economic expansion and positive equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST growth > 0.5% (3m) fails to produce positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100.0) signals an economic contraction, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100.0 fails to produce negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rising inflation rate (CPIAUCSL 3-month change > 0.5%) signals increased monetary policy tightening, reducing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL 3m change > 0.5% fails to produce negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 4.5%) signals labor market weakness, reducing consumer spending and economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.5% fails to produce negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances.
